text: Subject: F-23019/9/2019-ERM Government of India Ministry of Commerce & Industry Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (ERM Section) Udyog Bhavan, New Delhi dated the 03 September , 2019 OFFICE MEMORANDUM Compliance of the order of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the matter of Shri Anuj Goyal vs.UOI and others - identification of posts for PwDS-regarding. The undersigned is directed to refer to subject mentioned above and to forward a copy of report of Expert Committee regarding identification of posts suitable for persons with disabilities to be uploaded on DPIIT website. Further it is also requested that the Link address of the website on which the information has been uploaded may kindly be provided to this section so that the same may be forwarded to Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities. Encls. Retirement Matters Section) *** Minutes of the meeting of the Expert Committee held on 26 th July, 2019 in Udyog Bhawan, New Delhi on identification of posts suitable to be filled up from new categories of disabilities mentioned in RPwD Act, 2016. A meeting of the expert committee constituted for identifying the posts suitable for Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) as per provisions of RPwD Act, 2016 was held on 26th July, 2019 under the chairmanship of Dr. Ashish Kumar, SDO with the following members: {i) Dr. Ashish Kumar, Sr. Development Officer, DPIIT {ii) Sh. Yogesh Gupta, Deputy Secretary, DPIIT {iii) Sh. Shambhu Datt Sati, Under Secretary, DPIIT {iv) Sh. D.K. Panda, Under Secretary, D/o EPwD {v) Ms. Gurdeep Anand, Private Secretary, DPIIT 2.
